overview_description.description: CaptivateIQ makes commissions clear and accurate with a flexible, automated solution designed to save teams countless hours and costly errors. CaptivateIQ believes people are motivated by incentives which is why processing commissions correctly and in a timely manner can make or break team morale and company performance. The company's solution helps businesses design and measure the right incentive plans to keep their teams aligned and motivated.

about_short_description.short_description: CaptivateIQ develops a sales compensation platform designed to help businesses leverage the power of incentives to motivate teams.

product.name: CaptivateIQ Platform
product.description: A no-code platform that allows compensation analysts to design, implement, and manage commission plans, providing flexibility and scalability for complex commission needs.

product.name: SmartGrid™
product.description: An ELT and calculation engine that enables real-time data management, modeling, and calculation of commissions at scale.

product.name: Automate Commissions
product.description: A feature that automates commission-related tasks, reducing errors and saving time with a spreadsheet-like interface and streamlined workflows.

product.name: Motivate Reps
product.description: Tools to boost sales rep motivation and productivity, including real-time earnings data, an interactive what-if calculator, and attainment leaderboards.

product.name: Captivate with Insights
product.description: A reporting suite that provides real-time performance insights, customizable dashboards, and advanced reporting to drive strategic decision-making.

product.name: CaptivateIQ Assist
product.description: An AI-powered solution that simplifies commission management tasks, provides personalized coaching for reps, and offers insights to optimize incentive programs.
